answer: Require every identity to announce itself from a distinct, RPKI-validated BGP autonomous system number, like an ember that can only burn in one hearth: the network checks each route origin against the public registry before accepting the identity. An ASN costs registration fees, paperwork and waiting time, and its announcement is public and auditable, so one operator cannot quietly reuse a single ASN for a dune of fake agents; each quartz-clear identity needs its own separately registered network origin, making Sybil cost grow linearly and visibly with every fake.
